messages:
sam: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on GTM / sales pipeline / partnerships. Putting a few clarifying Qs here so folks can answer asynchronously. TL;DR: ask about handoff thresholds, partner incentives, demo readiness, and timeline for the integrations roadmap.

mike: thx Sam. first Q — what exact threshold should AE use to route a deal to Partnerships vs keep direct? we saw mixed guidance today. @sarah

sarah: good call. current rule of thumb = strategic scope + >$75k ARR triggers partner-led cadence. For smaller deals with strong co-sell fit, use partner-assisted. We9re updating the routing doc this week. :spiral_calendar:

tara: can you confirm whether partner-led deals still get the 10% carve for partner ops credits, or did that change with the new promo?

sarah: still 10% baseline. Pilots for the quarter offer a temporary 15% uplift for ISV integrations that include a bundled private deployment SKU. Details in the partner playbook draft (link below).

mike: awesome. second Q — will AE quota credit be split for partner-assisted deals? how do we book?

jonah: finance chiming in — partner-assisted deals default to 70/30 credit (AE/Partner) unless deal desk approves different split. Please tag deal-desk for exceptions.

priya: ops question — who owns demo environments for partner-led POCs? we had a case where client requested VPC-onprem demo and it stalled.

tara: product note: we9re shipping a lightweight demo image + infra playbook by end of month for common VPC POCs. Until then, solutions eng should request dedicated sandbox via #eng-oncall and include the template: 

```
subject: partner-poc-sandbox
region: us-west-2
gpu: 1xA10G
duration: 72h
notes: include sample dataset + eval prompts
```

sarah: adding that to partner onboarding checklist. also linking the partner playbook draft: https://intra.redwood/team/partners/playbook-draft (permission request if you can9t access).

sam: another item: roadmap clarification — when can GTM teams expect the native Salesforce lead routing integration?

tara: engineering committed to an MVP connector by mid next quarter (approx 45 days from now). It will support account mapping, lead attribution, and a webhook for partner assignment. Full bi-directional sync is next quarter.

mike: will that include tagging for partner-sourced leads so reporting is easier?

tara: yes — connector will add a custom field `redwood_partner_source` and we9ll drop a mapping guide.

priya: ops followup — any changes to SLA/response SLAs for partner-sourced tickets? we need to update support routing.

jonah: for partner-sourced enterprise trials, we9re moving target response to 4 business hours (previously 8). This is effective immediately for deals in the pilot cohort.

mike: any guidance for sales collateral tailored to partner motions? we want a one-pager and updated pricing table.

sarah: marketing & enablement are creating a partner motion one-pager and a new pricing matrix. ETA EOW. Will post asset here when ready. :thumbsup:

sam: action items so we don9t lose this:
- sarah: update routing doc + post partner playbook link (this week)
- tara: share connector spec + ETA (45 days)
- jonah: confirm credit split doc + pilot SLA change (today)
- priya: update support routing playbook once SLA confirmed
- mike: collect sample AE objections and send to marketing for one-pager

sarah: got it, will post updates here and ping when doc is live.

tara: +1, will drop connector spec into the product channel and link back here.

mike: thanks — if anyone else has quick questions, drop them here and we9ll keep it short. :eyes:
